Class Building

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.buildings.Building
Direct Known Subclasses:
EndGameBuilding, HuntEventBuilding, ImmediateBuilding, InventorsBuilding, PaintEventBuilding, PassiveBuilding, SetBuilding, ShamanBonusEventBuilding, ShamanMalusEventBuilding, SustenanceEventBuilding
public abstract class Building extends Card
Represents an abstract Building card within the game.

This class extends Card and defines the core attributes and behaviors of a building, such as its cost, prestige points, and the strategy used to apply its specific effect. It also supports the Visitor Pattern through the accept(BuildingVisitor) method to handle specialized building types dynamically.

Serialization and deserialization are handled polimorphically via Jackson annotations, mapping subclasses based on the "type" property.

    • Building

      public Building(int cost, int prestigePoints, int age, int id, EffectStrategy effectStrategy)
      Constructs a new Building card with the specified attributes. This constructor is annotated for Jackson JSON deserialization.
      Parameters:
      cost - the food cost required to purchase the building
      prestigePoints - the prestige points awarded by this building
      age - the historical age/era the card belongs to (passed to super)
      id - the unique identifier of the card (passed to super)
      effectStrategy - the strategy defining the effect triggered by this building

    • buy

      public void buy(Player player)
      Executes the purchase action of the building for a player.

      Deducts the appropriate amount of food from the player (clamping the maximum discount so the player doesn't gain food from buying) and adds this building to the player's tribe.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player purchasing the building
